# Selected original code from Morimoto and colleagues

This directory preserves selected, unmodified MATLAB analysis files from
[gloss_tinynetworks](https://github.com/takuma929/gloss_tinynetworks), the source
repository for *Human gloss perception reproduced by tiny neural networks*.
It is a methodological provenance archive, not a complete distribution of the
original study's data, dependencies or trained networks.

The original MIT [license](LICENSE), copyright 2025 Takuma Morimoto, is retained.
Source information and file hashes are recorded in [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json).
The locally supplied source ZIP did not establish an upstream commit identifier;
no commit identifier is inferred.

The upstream README is preserved byte-for-byte as
[README.upstream.md](README.upstream.md). The `README.md` hash in
`PROVENANCE.json` refers to that archived upstream file, not this directory guide.
Its installation instructions, thumbnail link and publication-status statements
describe the original source snapshot; the thumbnail and complete upstream data
are not included here. Consult the upstream repository for its current materials.

These scripts are distinct from this study's independently implemented
tiny-network control; see [PACKAGE_NOTE.md](PACKAGE_NOTE.md). They are also not
the entry point for reproducing this project's six main figures and supplement.
For that workflow, follow the [repository quick start](../../../README.md) or the
[figure reproduction guide](../../../docs/figure_reproduction.md).
